notes.question: GTA 6 at $80 is cheaper than GTA 5 was
notes.angle: GTA 6 standard costs $79.99 (Rockstar, Jun 2026). GTA V launched at $59.99 in Sept 2013. Adjusted for US inflation (BLS CPI calculator) $59.99 in 2013 is about $82-85 today, so GTA 6 costs less in real money; outlets ran the same maths and found it the cheapest mainline GTA at launch. Compare ONLY GTA 6 and GTA 5 (we have no images of older games). When the 2013 GTA 5 price is said, show the official GTA 5 cover (v_c670974867) or Los Santos (v_24ba6644de); for GTA 6 show Jason and Lucia or Vice City. - EVERY picture is an OFFICIAL Rockstar image. In "images", each value is exactly 'OFFICIAL:<id>' using ONLY ids from the catalogue below (the framing is automatic). No generated pictures, no real-world stock photos. Use GTA VI images for GTA 6 and GTA V images whenever GTA 5 is mentioned (comparisons: show both).

- Say 'GTA 6' in beat 1 or 2 and in the title. Never present rumours or speculation as fact: say 'reportedly' or 'Rockstar hasn't said' where the sources hedge.

- Length 30-38 seconds: 55-65 words in total (prices and years take long to say). 10-12 beats, each 4-7 words, so no picture is held longer than 3 seconds.

- EVERY picture is an OFFICIAL Rockstar image. In "images", each value is exactly 'OFFICIAL:<id>' using ONLY ids from the catalogue below (the framing is automatic). - EVERY picture is an OFFICIAL Rockstar image. In "images", each value is exactly 'OFFICIAL:<id>' using ONLY ids from the catalogue below (the framing is automatic). notes.question: Is GTA 6's map as big as real Florida?
notes.angle: GTA 6 is set in Leonida, Rockstar's version of Florida, with Vice City (Miami) (Rockstar). Real Florida is about 170,000 km2. Game maps are tiny by comparison; only use map-size figures that sources report and mark fan estimates as estimates. Point: games shrink the real place to its most recognisable parts.
